---- MODULE Zab ----
EXTENDS ZabDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AgentFS == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

LEMMA AgentCardinalityBridge ==
  \A S : AgentFS!Cardinality(S) = Cardinality(S)
  BY DEF AgentFS!Cardinality, Cardinality

AgentAllInitial ==
  /\ Leadership1
  /\ Leadership2
  /\ PrefixConsistency
  /\ Integrity
  /\ Agreement
  /\ TotalOrder
  /\ LocalPrimaryOrder
  /\ GlobalPrimaryOrder
  /\ PrimaryIntegrity

LEMMA AgentTxnReflexive == \A t : TxnEqual(t,t)
  BY DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AgentTxnSymmetric == \A t,u : TxnEqual(t,u) => TxnEqual(u,t)
  BY DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AgentTxnTransitive ==
  \A t,u,v : TxnEqual(t,u) /\ TxnEqual(u,v) => TxnEqual(t,v)
  BY DEF TxnEqual, ZxidEqual

LEMMA AgentMinimumPair ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Nat, NEW b \in Nat
  PROVE /\ Minimum({a,b}) \in Nat
        /\ Minimum({a,b}) <= a
        /\ Minimum({a,b}) <= b
        /\ Minimum({a,b}) = a \/ Minimum({a,b}) = b
<1>1. \E n \in {a,b} : \A m \in {a,b} : n <= m
  BY SMTT("r5")
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum

LEMMA AgentInitSafety == Init => AgentAllInitial
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Leadership1, IsLeader,
                      LOOKING, LEADING
<1>2. Init => Leadership2
  BY AgentFS!FS_EmptySet, AgentCardinalityBridge, SMTT("r5")
     DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, Leadership2, AgentFS!FS_EmptySet
<1>3. Init => PrefixConsistency
  BY AgentMinimumPair, SMTT("r5")
     DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrefixConsistency, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
<1>4. Init => Integrity
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Integrity, IsFollower,
                      LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>5. Init => Agreement
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Agreement, IsFollower,
                      LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>6. Init => TotalOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, TotalOrder
<1>7. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, LocalPrimaryOrder
<1>8. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>9. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrimaryIntegrity,
                      IsLeader, LOOKING, LEADING
<1>10. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9
     DEF AgentAllInitial

\* Connections and learner sets describe disjoint leader/follower groups.
AgentTopology ==
  /\ state \in [Server -> {LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING}]
  /\ learners \in [Server -> SUBSET Server]
  /\ connectInfo \in [Server -> Server \cup {NullPoint}]
  /\ \A s \in Server:
       /\ (~IsLeader(s) => learners[s] = {})
       /\ (~IsFollower(s) => connectInfo[s] = NullPoint)
       /\ (IsLeader(s) =>
             /\ s \in learners[s]
             /\ \A t \in learners[s] \ {s}:
                  IsFollower(t) /\ connectInfo[t] = s)
       /\ (IsFollower(s) /\ HasLeader(s) =>
             IsLeader(connectInfo[s]) /\ s \in learners[connectInfo[s]])

LEMMA AgentTopologyInitially == Init => AgentTopology
  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r5")
     DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitLeaderVars, InitFollowerVars,
         AgentTopology, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader,
         LOOKING, FOLLOWING, LEADING

LEMMA AgentDropLeader ==
  ASSUME AgentTopology, NEW i \in Server, IsLeader(i), LeaderShutdown(i)
  PROVE AgentTopology'
  BY SMTT("r20") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderShutdown, IsLeader, IsFollower,
                       HasLeader, LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AgentDropFollower ==
  ASSUME AgentTopology, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
         IsLeader(i), IsFollower(j), IsMyLeader(j,i),
         RemoveLearner(i,j), FollowerShutdown(j)
  PROVE AgentTopology'
  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF AgentTopology, RemoveLearner, FollowerShutdown,
         IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLeader, HasLeader, LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AgentDropUnconnectedFollower ==
  ASSUME AgentTopology, NEW i \in Server, IsFollower(i), ~HasLeader(i),
         FollowerShutdown(i), UNCHANGED learners
  PROVE AgentTopology'
  BY NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
     DEF AgentTopology, FollowerShutdown, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader,
         LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING

LEMMA AgentTopologyPreserved ==
  AgentTopology /\ [Next]_vars => AgentTopology'
<1>1. ASSUME AgentTopology, [Next]_vars
      PROVE AgentTopology'
  <2>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>2. CASE \E i \in Server: UpdateLeader(i)
    BY <1>1, <2>2, SMTT("r10")
       DEF AgentTopology, UpdateLeader, SwitchToLeader, IsLooking,
           IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader, LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING,
           followerVars
  <2>3. CASE \E i \in Server: FollowLeader(i)
    BY <1>1, <2>3, SMTT("r10")
       DEF AgentTopology, FollowLeader, SwitchToLeader, SwitchToFollower,
           IsLooking, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader,
           LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, followerVars, leaderVars
  <2>4. CASE \E i,j \in Server: Timeout(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>4, AgentDropLeader, AgentDropFollower, SMTT("r5") DEF Timeout
  <2>5. CASE \E i \in Server: Restart(i)
    BY <1>1, <2>5, AgentDropLeader, AgentDropFollower,
       AgentDropUnconnectedFollower, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
       DEF Restart, AgentTopology, IsMyLeader, IsLooking, IsLeader,
           IsFollower, HasLeader, LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, followerVars
  <2>6. CASE \E i,j \in Server: ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>6, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
       DEF AgentTopology, ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH,
           IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader, HasNoLeader, IsMyLearner,
           LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, serverVars
  <2>7. CASE \E i,j \in Server: LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>7, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderProcessCEPOCH, followerVars,
               IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>8. CASE \E i,j \in Server: FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>8, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
       DEF AgentTopology, FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, RemoveLearner,
           FollowerShutdown, IsMyLeader, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader,
           LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, followerVars
  <2>9. CASE \E i,j \in Server: LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>9, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH, followerVars,
               IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>10. CASE \E i,j \in Server: FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>10, NullPointNotServer, SMTT("r10")
       DEF AgentTopology, FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, RemoveLearner,
           FollowerShutdown, IsMyLeader, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader,
           LOOKING, LEADING, FOLLOWING, followerVars
  <2>11. CASE \E i,j \in Server: LeaderProcessACKLD(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>11, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderProcessACKLD, followerVars,
                IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>12. CASE \E i,j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMITLD(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>12, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, FollowerProcessCOMMITLD,
                leaderVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>13. CASE \E i \in Server: LeaderProcessRequest(i)
    BY <1>1, <2>13, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderProcessRequest,
                leaderVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>14. CASE \E i \in Server: LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE(i)
    BY <1>1, <2>14, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE,
                serverVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>15. CASE \E i,j \in Server: FollowerProcessPROPOSE(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>15, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, FollowerProcessPROPOSE,
                leaderVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>16. CASE \E i,j \in Server: LeaderProcessACK(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>16, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, LeaderProcessACK,
                leaderVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>17. CASE \E i,j \in Server: FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i,j)
    BY <1>1, <2>17, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, FollowerProcessCOMMIT,
                leaderVars, followerVars, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
  <2>18. QED
    BY SMTT("r5"), <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8,
       <2>9, <2>10, <2>11, <2>12, <2>13, <2>14, <2>15, <2>16, <2>17
       DEF Next
<1>2. QED BY <1>1

LEMMA AgentTopologyInvariant == Spec => []AgentTopology
<1>1. Init => AgentTopology
  BY AgentTopologyInitially
<1>2. AgentTopology /\ [Next]_vars => AgentTopology'
  BY AgentTopologyPreserved
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA AgentLearnersDisjoint ==
  AgentTopology =>
    \A i,j \in Server: IsLeader(i) /\ IsLeader(j) /\ i # j
      => learners[i] \cap learners[j] = {}
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentTopology, IsLeader, IsFollower,
                      LEADING, FOLLOWING


AgentCommitNatural == \A s \in Server : lastCommitted[s].index \in Nat

AgentNoRepeats ==
  \A s \in Server : \A a,b \in 1..lastCommitted[s].index :
    TxnEqual(history[s][a], history[s][b]) => a = b

AgentEpochOrdered ==
  \A s \in Server : \A a,b \in 1..lastCommitted[s].index :
    a <= b => history[s][a].zxid[1] <= history[s][b].zxid[1]

AgentEpochTyped ==
  \A s \in Server : \A a \in 1..lastCommitted[s].index :
    history[s][a].zxid[1] \in Nat

AgentIntegrityAll ==
  \A s \in Server : \A a \in 1..lastCommitted[s].index :
    \E p \in proposalMsgsLog :
      TxnEqual(history[s][a], [zxid |-> p.zxid, value |-> p.data])

LEMMA AgentInitialHistoryFacts ==
  Init => /\ AgentCommitNatural
          /\ AgentNoRepeats
          /\ AgentEpochOrdered
          /\ AgentEpochTyped
          /\ AgentIntegrityAll
<1>1. Init => AgentCommitNatural /\ AgentNoRepeats
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, AgentCommitNatural, AgentNoRepeats
<1>2. Init => AgentEpochOrdered /\ AgentEpochTyped
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, AgentEpochOrdered,
                      AgentEpochTyped, BootstrapTxn, BootstrapZxid
<1>3. Init => AgentIntegrityAll
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, InitVerifyVars,
                      BootstrapTxn, BootstrapZxid, BootstrapProposalMsgs,
                      AgentIntegrityAll, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3

\* A common committed index denotes the same transaction at both servers.
LEMMA AgentCommonIndex ==
  ASSUME AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency,
         NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
         NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
         k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
  PROVE TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][k])
<1>1. LET m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index})
      IN /\ m \in Nat
         /\ m = lastCommitted[i].index \/ m = lastCommitted[j].index
  BY AgentMinimumPair DEF AgentCommitNatural
<1>2. LET m == Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index})
      IN m > 0 /\ k \in 1..m
  BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
<1>3. QED
  BY <1>2 DEF PrefixConsistency

LEMMA AgentAgreementFromPrefix ==
  AgentCommitNatural /\ PrefixConsistency => Agreement
<1>1. ASSUME AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             NEW a \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW b \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      PROVE \/ \E k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index:
                   TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[i][a])
            \/ \E k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index:
                   TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][b])
  <2>1. CASE a <= lastCommitted[j].index
    <3>1. a \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      BY <1>1, <2>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[j][a])
      BY <1>1, <3>1, AgentCommonIndex
    <3>3. QED BY <1>1, <3>1, <3>2, AgentTxnSymmetric
  <2>2. CASE ~(a <= lastCommitted[j].index)
    <3>1. b \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
      BY <1>1, <2>2, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[i][b], history[j][b])
      BY <1>1, <3>1, AgentCommonIndex
    <3>3. QED BY <1>1, <3>1, <3>2
  <2>3. QED BY <2>1, <2>2
<1>2. QED BY <1>1 DEF Agreement

\* Prefix consistency and absence of repeated transactions fix the index
\* of every transaction that is committed at more than one server.
LEMMA AgentEqualCommittedIndices ==
  ASSUME AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, AgentNoRepeats,
         NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
         NEW a \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
         NEW b \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index,
         TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[j][b])
  PROVE a = b
<1>1. CASE a <= lastCommitted[j].index
  <2>1. a \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
  <2>2. TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[j][a])
    BY <2>1, AgentCommonIndex
  <2>3. TxnEqual(history[j][a], history[j][b])
    BY <2>2, AgentTxnSymmetric, AgentTxnTransitive
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>3 DEF AgentNoRepeats
<1>2. CASE ~(a <= lastCommitted[j].index)
  <2>1. b \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
    BY <1>2, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
  <2>2. TxnEqual(history[i][b], history[j][b])
    BY <2>1, AgentCommonIndex
  <2>3. TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[i][b])
    BY <2>2, AgentTxnSymmetric, AgentTxnTransitive
  <2>4. QED BY <2>1, <2>3 DEF AgentNoRepeats
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgentTotalOrderFromPrefix ==
  AgentCommitNatural /\ PrefixConsistency /\ AgentNoRepeats => TotalOrder
<1>1. ASSUME AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, AgentNoRepeats,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             NEW a \in 1..(lastCommitted[i].index - 1),
             NEW b \in (a+1)..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index,
             TxnEqual(history[i][b], history[j][k])
      PROVE /\ TxnEqual(history[i][b], history[j][b])
            /\ b \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
            /\ a \in 1..(b-1)
            /\ TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[j][a])
  <2>1. a \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index /\ b \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
  <2>2. b = k
    BY <1>1, <2>1, AgentEqualCommittedIndices
  <2>3. a \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index /\ a \in 1..(b-1)
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>2, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural
  <2>4. TxnEqual(history[i][a], history[j][a])
    BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>3, AgentCommonIndex
  <2>5. QED BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4
<1>2. QED
  BY <1>1 DEF TotalOrder

LEMMA AgentGlobalOrderFromEpochOrder ==
  AgentCommitNatural /\ AgentEpochTyped /\ AgentEpochOrdered
    => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitNatural, AgentEpochTyped,
                      AgentEpochOrdered, GlobalPrimaryOrder, EpochPrecedeInTxn

LEMMA AgentIntegrityFromAll == AgentIntegrityAll => Integrity
  BY DEF AgentIntegrityAll, Integrity


\* Candidate state strengthenings for the remaining protocol obligations.
AgentLeadershipCandidate == AgentTopology /\ Leadership1
AgentPrefixCandidate == AgentCommitNatural /\ PrefixConsistency
AgentTotalCandidate == AgentPrefixCandidate /\ AgentNoRepeats
AgentGlobalCandidate == AgentCommitNatural /\ AgentEpochTyped /\ AgentEpochOrdered

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership1
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership1.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentLeadershipCandidate
  BY AgentInitSafety, AgentTopologyInitially
     DEF AgentAllInitial, AgentLeadershipCandidate, AgentTopology, Leadership1, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
<1>2. AgentLeadershipCandidate /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentLeadershipCandidate'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentLeadershipCandidate, AgentTopology, Leadership1, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
\* The non-stuttering case also needs invariants relating queued messages
\* and quorum snapshots to the current epochs and committed histories.
<1>3. AgentLeadershipCandidate /\ Next => AgentLeadershipCandidate'
  BY AgentTopologyPreserved, SMTT("r1")
     DEF AgentLeadershipCandidate, AgentTopology, Leadership1, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader, Next, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader, Timeout, Restart,
         ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, LeaderProcessACKLD,
         FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, LeaderProcessRequest,
         LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, FollowerProcessPROPOSE,
         LeaderProcessACK, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>4. Spec => []AgentLeadershipCandidate
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF Spec
<1>5. AgentLeadershipCandidate => Leadership1
  BY DEF AgentLeadershipCandidate, AgentTopology, Leadership1, IsLeader, IsFollower, HasLeader
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership1.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership2
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership2.tla
<1>1. Init => Leadership2
  BY AgentInitSafety DEF AgentAllInitial
<1>2. Leadership2 /\ UNCHANGED epochLeader => Leadership2'
  BY DEF Leadership2
\* The missing election invariant must ensure that adding i here cannot
\* introduce a second member into the set for acceptedEpoch[i].
<1>3. ASSUME Leadership2, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i,j)
      PROVE Leadership2'
  BY <1>3, SMTT("r1") DEF Leadership2, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH
<1>4. Leadership2 /\ Next => Leadership2'
  BY <1>2, <1>3, SMTT("r5")
     DEF Next, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader, Timeout, Restart,
         ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, LeaderProcessACKLD,
         FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, LeaderProcessRequest,
         LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, FollowerProcessPROPOSE,
         LeaderProcessACK, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, verifyVars
<1>5. Leadership2 /\ [Next]_vars => Leadership2'
  BY <1>2, <1>4 DEF vars, verifyVars
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>1, <1>5, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership2.tla

THEOREM Spec => []PrefixConsistency
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrefixConsistency.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentPrefixCandidate
  BY AgentInitSafety, AgentInitialHistoryFacts
     DEF AgentAllInitial, AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency
<1>2. AgentPrefixCandidate /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentPrefixCandidate'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
\* The non-stuttering case also needs invariants relating queued messages
\* and quorum snapshots to the current epochs and committed histories.
<1>3. AgentPrefixCandidate /\ Next => AgentPrefixCandidate'
  BY SMTT("r1")
     DEF AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, Next, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader, Timeout, Restart,
         ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, LeaderProcessACKLD,
         FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, LeaderProcessRequest,
         LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, FollowerProcessPROPOSE,
         LeaderProcessACK, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>4. Spec => []AgentPrefixCandidate
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF Spec
<1>5. AgentPrefixCandidate => PrefixConsistency
  BY DEF AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrefixConsistency.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Integrity
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Integrity.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentIntegrityAll
  BY AgentInitialHistoryFacts
     DEF AgentAllInitial, AgentIntegrityAll
<1>2. AgentIntegrityAll /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentIntegrityAll'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentIntegrityAll, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
\* The non-stuttering case also needs invariants relating queued messages
\* and quorum snapshots to the current epochs and committed histories.
<1>3. AgentIntegrityAll /\ Next => AgentIntegrityAll'
  BY SMTT("r1")
     DEF AgentIntegrityAll, Next, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader, Timeout, Restart,
         ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, LeaderProcessACKLD,
         FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, LeaderProcessRequest,
         LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE, FollowerProcessPROPOSE,
         LeaderProcessACK, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>4. Spec => []AgentIntegrityAll
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF Spec
<1>5. AgentIntegrityAll => Integrity
  BY AgentIntegrityFromAll DEF AgentIntegrityAll
<1>6. QED
  BY <1>4, <1>5, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Integrity.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Agreement
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Agreement.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentPrefixCandidate
  BY AgentInitSafety, AgentInitialHistoryFacts
     DEF AgentAllInitial, AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency
<1>2. AgentPrefixCandidate /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentPrefixCandidate'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, vars, serverVars, leaderVars, followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
\* The non-stuttering case also needs invariants relating queued messages
\* and quorum snapshots to the current epochs and committed histories.
<1>3. AgentPrefixCandidate /\ Next => AgentPrefixCandidate'
  BY SMTT("r1")
     DEF AgentPrefixCandidate, AgentCommitNatural, PrefixConsistency, Next, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader, Timeout, Restart,
         ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
         FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, LeaderProcessACKEPOCH,
